description: This file defines a DragBehavior class for enabling drag interactions on widgets in the Kivy framework, including an example usage with a draggable label.

classes.name: DragBehavior
classes.description: A mixin class providing drag behavior to widgets, allowing them to be moved within a specified rectangle when dragged.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events to initiate dragging if within the drag rectangle.

methods.name: on_touch_move
methods.description: Handles touch move events to update widget position during dragging.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch release events to finalize dragging.

methods.name: _do_touch_up
methods.description: Performs cleanup and state reset after touch up.

methods.name: _change_touch_mode
methods.description: Changes the touch mode to start dragging after a timeout.

methods.name: _get_uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for touch events.
